On March 23, 2017, CBS renewed the series for a second season, which premiered on September 25, 2017.
Patrick Troughton | Patrick George Troughton ( , 25 March 1920 – 28 March 1987) was an English actor. Ellington starred as Oliver Hunt in "The Elephant King" (2006), and has appeared in television shows such as "The Unusuals", "Rescue Me", "The Good Wife", and "Don't Trust the B---- in Apartment 23".  He appeared in the 2009 Broadway production of "The Philanthropist", which starred Matthew Broderick.  He is best known for his role as FBI recruit Simon Asher on the ABC thriller "Quantico".
